name: Vera Blanc and the Identity Thief
source:
Take on the role of Vera Blanc, a beautiful young woman with the extraordinary ability to read other people's minds!
Daughter of Emmanuel Blanc, Vera left a life of luxury to work alongside paranormal detective Brandon Mackey. 
Vera Blanc immerses you in the world of the supernatural as you play the detective!
This is a fan made visual novel, based on the Vera Blanc characters created by winterwolves games. The Vera Blanc characters are used with the permission of Winterwolves Games.

In this game Vera Blanc and her partner Brandon Mackey travel to Atlanta to investigate a case of identity theft. 
Will you be able to solve the mystery? The game ending you get depends on choices you make. Game play includes a challenging mini-game.

[From [url=http://wolflore.net/viewtopic.php?f=37&t=1359]Wolflore[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演维拉·布朗克——一名拥有读心这一非凡能力的美丽年轻女子！
维拉是伊曼纽尔 布朗克的女儿。她放弃奢华生活，与超自然侦探布兰登·麦基并肩工作。
扮演侦探的你将通过维拉·布朗克沉浸在超自然世界之中！
这是一部同人视觉小说，基于Winterwolves Games创作的维拉·布朗克角色改编。维拉·布朗克角色的使用已获得Winterwolves Games许可。

在本作中，维拉·布朗克和搭档布兰登·麦基前往亚特兰大，调查一起身份盗窃案件。
你能解开这个谜团吗？你得到的游戏结局取决于自己的选择。游戏中还包含一个颇具挑战性的小游戏。
